subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt and narrow the open uneditable fork PR, replace it with a same-repo repair, or close that candidate first?
rationale: The issue remains valid, but an open fork PR with closing syntax blocks queueing another automatic fix until a human resolves the stale branch and ownership state.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the uneditable fork PR and land only the config schema/generated-artifact fix in this repository.

options.title: Adopt And Rebase Fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer take over the fork branch, drop stale unrelated daemon/systemd changes, and keep the contributor's schema repair credit.

options.title: Leave Waiting On Fork PR
options.body: Keep the issue paired to the existing PR, accepting that the conflicting uneditable branch may continue to stall the fix.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the uneditable fork PR and land only the config schema/generated-artifact fix in this repository.

likelyOwner.reason: The documented config behavior traces to steipete's exec approval-id work, and the remaining decision is how to carry that config contract forward.
